{{Quote|Here comes the customs official.|The Moogan smuggler, to Tee Va|<ref name="corrupt">{{TCW|Corruption (episode)}}</ref>}}
This '''Moogan smuggler''' was part of [[Tee Va/Legends|Tee Va's]] crew of smugglers active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Welcome back gentlemen, I'm here for my&hellip;inspection.''"<br />"''Certainly. We would expect nothing less.|The Mandalorian customs official and the Moogan smuggler while the latter bribes the former|<ref name="corrupt" />}}
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> because the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] opted for neutrality in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], supply lines had been severed from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], and the inhabitants had to rely on black markets for food and other necessary needs. This smuggler, along with a few [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] servants, and [[Tee Va/Legends|Tee Va]], another [[Moogan/Legends|Moogan]], traveled to Mandalore to deliver [[Tea/Legends|tea]]. But Tee Va decided to double the profit by adding [[Slabin/Legends|slabin]] to the tea, which in turn made it poisonous. One night, when the crew arrived at night to deliver more tea, this Moogan smuggler met with the [[Unidentified Mandalorian customs official/Legends|customs officer]] and bribed him into letting them work. However, they were caught the next day by [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]], the [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], who had come to investigate the corruption, a few of Satine's bodyguards, and a [[Unidentified Mandalorian police captain (Sundari)|police captain]]. A firefight ensued, which resulted in the deaths of one of the Moogan smugglers, two Gotals, and two royal Mandalorian guards. The surviving smugglers were then arrested.

==Behind the scenes==
Near the end of the episode, one of Tee Va's companions is killed by Padmé Amidala, but it is unknown if it was this Moogan smuggler or Tee Va's other companion.
